rows.title: AI and accountability
rows.contest: Whether the companies building AI should answer for the harm it causes, or whether its benefits justify letting society absorb some of that harm.
rows.stakes: People who use AI chatbots, including teenagers, may carry risks nobody is yet required to answer for. How courts, regulators and the companies themselves settle that will decide who pays when the technology goes wrong.
